note: GET A HALCYON ROD ASAP. This rod covers rank 1-18 (every small fish through skill 50). Start Moorish Idols at skill 8+ in Bibiki Bay (Purgonorgo Isle) with Lugworm or Shrimp Lure — skill 26 fish, rank 9, perfect rod match. Rod rank mismatch kills catch rate more than level gap. One rod, one spot, skill 8 to 50. This changes the game.
Frog Lure in Giddeus — Dark Bass to Red Terrapin, no gear swap needed. Carbon Rod the whole way.
Millioncorn from Benaige in Southern San d'Oria is 48g, not 240g guild price. Cornstarch is vendor trash but cheap to make — float alchemy levels with it.

Halcyon Rod + Minnow Lure still lands Bastore Breams (skill 86, rank 22) at fishing 48. That's 38 levels under and 4 ranks past the rod's max of 18 — you'll lose some to 'lack of skill' but they DO land. The rod punches way above its stats. Skill-ups all the way to 86 from one spot.
Serving Of Beaugreen Saute bridges 53-55 (cook 55). Fire Crystal + Selbina Butter (60g guild vendor) + Beaugreens (105g regional vendor, 500g guild). Cheap if your nation holds regions.
